aspects.name: Immense
aspects.description: Doubles Energy gain from tracks; Power Cards cost +2 Energy (or +1 for Minor) but grant extra elements, pivoting Lightning into a Major Power titan.

aspects.name: Pandemonium
aspects.description: Replaces Thundering Destruction with Massive Fear generation and Strife instead of direct Town/City destruction.

aspects.name: Wind
aspects.description: Trades Raging Storm for high-mobility Range & Fast-speed support, pushing Invaders and Dahan across the island.

aspects.name: Sparking
aspects.description: Replaces Raging Storm & Shatter Homesteads with Sparking Impulse, gifting Power Cards and Fast-phase bursts to allies.

aspects.name: Sunshine
aspects.description: Replaces Boon of Vigor with a Sun-charged innate that grants massive Energy and Reclaim support to Spirits.

aspects.name: Travel
aspects.description: River's Presence forms Sacred Site bridges that carry Dahan along with moved Presence and grant Defend.

aspects.name: Haven
aspects.description: Trades offensive washout for protective Sacred Site sanctuaries that Defend lands and safeguard Dahan.

aspects.name: Reach
aspects.description: Allows Shadows to ignore Range once per turn without paying Energy, greatly smoothing early board coverage.

aspects.name: Amorphous
aspects.description: Presence becomes fluid—moving freely whenever Shadows uses powers or gathers/pushes Explorers.

aspects.name: Foreboding
aspects.description: Turns Fear generation into extra Explorer/Town control Pushes across lands with Shadows' Presence.

aspects.name: Madness
aspects.description: Inflicts Strife when placing Presence, turning Shadows into a close-range Dahan & Strife brawler.

aspects.name: Dark Fire
aspects.description: Grants both Moon and Fire affinity simultaneously and empowers Shadows with extra card-play / fire scaling.

aspects.name: Resilience
aspects.description: Replaces Earth's innate Defend 3 at Sacred Sites with Dahan health fortification (+5 Health) against Ravages.

aspects.name: Might
aspects.description: Trades passive Sacred Site defense for Earth Moves With Vigor and Might—amplifying Power Card damage and card draw.

aspects.name: Nourishing
aspects.description: Channels Vitality tokens and Dahan growth, healing Blight and fortifying the island's living ecosystems.

aspects.name: Regrowth
aspects.description: Focuses on reclaiming destroyed Presence from the island and regrowing lush defenses after Blight strikes.

aspects.name: Tangles
aspects.description: Weaves Wilds tokens and tangling undergrowth to halt Invader exploration and choke out inland expansion.

aspects.name: Enticing
aspects.description: Beguiles Invaders toward Sacred Sites with irresistible dream illusions, concentrating them for mass nightmares.

aspects.name: Violence
aspects.description: Unleashes furious night terrors that grant aggressive damage boosts and accelerate terror victories.

aspects.name: Transforming
aspects.description: Transmutes Invaders and Blight into Beasts, Badlands, and new life rather than pure scorched-earth destruction.

aspects.name: Spreading Hostility
aspects.description: Spreads Badlands and aggressive Wilds at the cost of slower Energy scaling, punishing Invaders across multiple lands.

aspects.name: Lair
aspects.description: Establishes an Incarna Lair that continually draws Explorers and Towns into a central wilderness kill-zone.

aspects.name: Deeps
aspects.description: Sinks coastal lands permanently into the Ocean itself, expanding Ocean's reach further inland as the game progresses.

aspects.name: Locus
aspects.description: Replaces Deep Slumber with an Incarna Locus that radiates elemental support and lets allies channel powers through Serpent.

aspects.name: Encircle
aspects.description: Rewards surrounding Invader lands with Beasts in adjacent territories to ambush and isolate prey.

aspects.name: Unconstrained
aspects.description: Lifts Blight restrictions on Sharp Fangs' Presence and Beasts, allowing relentless predator strikes even in blighted lands.

aspects.name: Intensify
aspects.description: Spends prepared Element tokens to directly amplify Power Card damage, Defend, and Fear values.

aspects.name: Mentor
aspects.description: Drafts and teaches Power Cards and prepared Element tokens to fellow Spirits, acting as the ultimate arch-tutor.

aspects.name: Stranded
aspects.description: Isolates Invaders in mist-shrouded lands, smoothing Shroud's early economy and controlling Explorer movement.

aspects.name: Tactician
aspects.description: Grants precise Dahan battlefield repositioning and tactical skirmish strikes each turn.

aspects.name: Warrior
aspects.description: Leads the Dahan with an Incarna Warrior avatar that deals direct combat damage alongside Dahan armies.

adversaries.name: The Habsburg Monarchy
adversaries.lossCondition: More Blight on a board than twice the number of Towns; or Tracked Town count on Wave 4+
adversaries.strategyNotes: Prioritize isolating inland lands before Build to stop Town migration; Diseases and Strife help survive heavy Ravages.

adversaries.name: The Kingdom of Brandenburg-Prussia
adversaries.lossCondition: Standard (Early Stage III Invader Card acceleration)
adversaries.strategyNotes: Fast tempo threat! Prioritize early card plays, Fast phase Explorer control, and rapid Fear generation before Stage III hits.

adversaries.name: The Kingdom of England
adversaries.lossCondition: 7 or more Towns and/or Cities in a single land (Proud & Mighty Capital)
adversaries.strategyNotes: Invaders build even without adjacent explorers if 2+ Invaders are present. Heavy damage, Town destruction, and Fear racing are key.

adversaries.name: The Kingdom of France
adversaries.lossCondition: Town supply pool (7 per board) runs out when placing a Town
adversaries.strategyNotes: Explorer control and Town destruction are critical to keep the Plantation Colony Town pool from depleting.

adversaries.name: The Kingdom of Scotland
adversaries.lossCondition: Number of Coastal lands with Cities exceeds 2 × number of boards
adversaries.strategyNotes: Guard Coastal lands relentlessly; prevent Coastal builds and watch out for Stage II Coastal escalation.

adversaries.name: The Kingdom of Sweden
adversaries.lossCondition: Standard (Heavy Mining adds extra Blight on 6+ Ravage damage)
adversaries.strategyNotes: Towns deal 3 and Cities deal 5 damage! Defend powers, Strife, and Explorer prevention stop devastating Blight cascades.

adversaries.name: The Tsardom of Russia
adversaries.lossCondition: Number of Beasts destroyed on the Adversary panel reaches or exceeds Beasts on the island
adversaries.strategyNotes: Explorers deal 2 damage and have Sense for Approaching Danger (pushed instead of destroyed once per action). Protect Beasts!

adversaries.name: Habsburg Mining Expedition
adversaries.lossCondition: Land has 8+ Invaders after Ravage Step
adversaries.strategyNotes: Disperse Clusters of 3+ Invaders (Mining Lands) so they cannot upgrade and immune-build.

matches.notes: EPIC GAME. Combo with Irresistable Call and The Jungle Hungers. Then finishing off with Consuming Void.
Into the Briny Deep they go together with half the island!
